data.title: Titomic outlines corporate governance practices and board oversight
data.description:
Titomic Ltd ( (AU:TTT) ) has provided an update.

Titomic, Inc. is a Delaware corporation whose directors and management say they are committed to ethical business conduct and the highest corporate-governance standards. The company has adopted and substantially complies with the ASX Corporate Governance Principles and Recommendations (Fourth Edition), to the extent appropriate for its size and the nature of its operations.

Its governance statement, approved by the Board as at 30 November 2026, sets out its practices and identifies any recommendations not followed, together with reasons. The Board oversees management, governance, strategy, operational and financial performance, and the annual business plan and budget, while the Managing Director operates within Board-delegated authority and remains accountable through regular reporting.

Before appointing a director or putting forward a candidate for election, the company undertakes checks on character, experience, education, criminal record and bankruptcy history. It also provides security holders with material information relevant to director election or re-election decisions.

data.title: Nankai to Dispose of Treasury Shares Under Employee Restricted Stock Plan
data.description:
An update from Nankai Electric Railway Co., Ltd. ( (JP:9044) ) is now available.

NANKAI Co., Ltd., listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange’s Prime Market, announced a restricted stock incentive plan for eligible manager-class employees through the Nankai Group Employee Stock Ownership Association (ESOA).

Under the plan, the company is scheduled to dispose of up to 23,600 treasury shares at ¥3,143 per share on Jan. 29, 2027, with a maximum total of ¥74,174,800, subject to the number of employees agreeing to participate. Each eligible employee will receive a ¥314,300 monetary claim and 100 restricted shares through the ESOA; the company says the arrangement is intended to promote shared value with shareholders and awareness of management participation.

data.title: Swift TV Shareholders Pass All Annual General Meeting Resolutions
data.description:
An announcement from Swift Networks Group Limited ( (AU:STV) ) is now available.

Swift TV Ltd is a technology company delivering enterprise in-room engagement and entertainment through Swift TV, its all-in-one connected TV product for scalable deployment in mining, oil and gas, aged care and hospitality. The product is designed to unify entertainment, communication and engagement while supporting integrations that optimise business outcomes.

All resolutions put to shareholders at the annual general meeting were passed by poll. They included adoption of the remuneration report, re-election of Bradley Denison, approval of additional 10% placement capacity, approval to issue 4,706,641 shares and 4,706,641 performance rights to Brian Mangano, and ratification of a prior issue of warrants to Pure Asset Management Pty Ltd.

data.title: ShiFang Holding Discloses Chen Ye Funding-Support Proposal
data.description:
ShiFang Holding Limited ( (HK:1831) ) has provided an update.

ShiFang Holding disclosed that executive Director Chen Ye had submitted a funding-support proposal to its board. The proposal is conditional on protection of original shareholders’ rights and interests and includes his stated willingness to contribute at least RMB200 million in cash for sustainable operating funds, intended to help satisfy conditions for resuming trading.

Chen Ye also offered an additional HK$10 million and advances for specified creditor obligations and Chinese Mainland legal fees; major creditors, employees with wage arrears, and certain directors and former directors would cooperate through financial-support documents. If shareholder protection cannot be achieved, Chen Ye and other affected parties may pursue legal proceedings seeking a winding-up on insolvency; several directors supported the proposal, while Chen Zhi expressed no opinion, and matters involving Hu Bin and Wu Wenlin remain pending with Shenzhen police.
